The "'''Ripclaw'''" was a name given to a large [[rakghoul]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. When [[Dark Plague|crazed]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cin Tykan]] opened the tunnels leading to the [[Taris Republic Expeditionary Forces headquarters|headquarters]] of the [[Republic Expeditionary Forces]] in [[3643 BBY]], Ripclaw was one of the many rakghouls that flooded the base. However, a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] who was [[Mission to Taris (Barsen'thor)|seeking]] to stop Tykan arrived at the base, sealed the tunnels and cleared the headquarters of the rakghouls, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Ripclaw in the process.
